天武神尊最新章节_第5章 自作孽不可活第1页_天武神尊风戈_热点小说网
> 第5章 自作孽不可活（第1页）
“我们并非康庄之人，只是绕康庄前行赶路。无论你在康庄是什么身份，只要我们不进入康庄，你就没必要这样咄咄逼人。”郑风无心惹事继续埋头赶路，对方实力远不如自己还是好言相劝。
“你们即便是绕康庄而行，也是在康庄附近，在我们的地界就得服从我们的命令。多说无益，还请队长下令，缉拿这一群人，若敢反抗，传讯附近的巡逻队支援。”队长旁边的青衣小哥，尖嘴猴腮，跃跃欲试。
“青猴传讯附近几队，等其他巡逻队一到再出手不迟。”队长自知不是郑风一行人对手，很是理智。
尖嘴猴腮的青猴正要传讯，却见一道剑光闪烁，整个人飞了起来。队长本要出手解围，却发现一道剑气已锁定在自己眉心处。队长冷汗直冒，身躯都不停地颤抖。其背后的几位队员，满脸惊恐。
郑风主动出击出乎他们意料，实力强劲得一塌糊涂，一招震飞青猴，还用剑气锁定了修为最高的队长眉心。郑风要是杀人，两人瞬间就会毙命，要团灭这个巡逻队就是眨一眨眼的时间，这就不是一个层面的战力。
三秒就是一眨眼的功夫，巡逻队长感觉了什么是一瞬万年的滋味，每一秒都在惊恐中度过，每一秒都是漫长的煎熬。
巡逻队长发现剑并没刺入脑子，自己还活着，清醒过来后果断下令，“让他们走！”
郑风拱手一礼，“刚才如有冒犯还请海涵，我们有急事需要赶路，就不继续叨扰了，告辞！”
郑风等人一走，披头散发的青猴就暴跳而起，拿起传讯腰牌“紧急呼救，村东水湾五百里处一群行人可疑，拒不接受盘查，还恶意伤人，啊！”
巡逻队长本想阻止青猴的行为，却发现惨叫声一起，青猴的头颅再次飞了起来，只不过这一次飞起的只有头颅。
“本无心伤人！”一道声音悠悠传来，巡逻队员听得清楚，是郑风的声音。那声音离此地已是很远。
“此人不是我们能招惹的，刚才大家也看到了，这一群人根本无心出手，是青猴紧紧相逼！”队长十分无奈，青猴是自作孽不可活。
一会后，一队人马来得神速，都骑着高头大马，一看就是附近的骑手巡逻队。
“是谁杀死了青猴，人在何处？”一青衣头领策马上来询问。
众人不知如何回答，关键是人家刚才再次放过了众人性命，杀死青猴的那一剑，众人记忆犹新，能无声无息杀死青猴，就能杀死他们中任何一人，人家心善，两次放过巡逻队成员，这时举报人家好吗？
巡逻队员沉默了，但作为巡逻队长，附近巡逻队赶来支援，却不得不回答。
“逃了吗？”一骑手询问，眼神满是轻蔑。
“青猴传讯时对方就已经走远！”队长本想令青衣头领罢手，青衣头领虽是初阶武君修为，但巡逻队长也觉得他不是郑风的对手。

“呵呵，说笑呢，青猴传讯到现在也就是聊几句话的功夫，已经远离的人还瞬间回来杀死了他不成？”青衣队长不信，随后的骑手没一人相信。
“走，我们这队去追！麻烦指个方向。”青衣头领策马疾驰，几匹骏马疾驰而去。
“走，我们回去继续巡逻，刚才之事谁也不用提起。”巡逻队长深知这一队骑手的结局。他可是不久前才与鬼门关擦身而过，要不是郑风心慈手软，差一点就进去了。自己也已隐晦地提醒了对方实力，作为巡逻队长，总不能明言放弃追踪，那是渎职。
巡逻队长带着几位队员，向着来时的方向继续巡逻了。就当刚才的事情没有发生，他再也不想经历一次刚才的刺激。

The latest chapter of Tianwu God Zun_Chapter 5 You will not survive because of your own sins Page 1_Tianwu God Zun Feng Ge_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 5: Self-inflicted evil will lead to death (Page 1)
"We are not from Kangzhuang, we are just going around Kangzhuang. No matter what your status is in Kangzhuang, as long as we don't enter Kangzhuang, there is no need for you to be so aggressive." Zheng Feng did not want to cause trouble and continued to immerse himself in his way. The opponent was far less powerful than himself but he still tried to persuade him.
"Even if you go around Kangzhuang, you are still near Kangzhuang. If you are in our territory, you must obey our orders. It is useless to say more. I also ask the captain to give an order to arrest this group of people. If you dare to resist, summon the nearby patrol team for support." The young man in green next to the captain, with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks, is eager to try.
"Green Monkey summoned several nearby teams and waited for other patrol teams to arrive before taking action." The captain knew that he was no match for Zheng Feng and his group, so he was very sensible.
The green monkey with a pointed mouth and monkey cheeks was about to send a message when he saw a flash of sword light and he flew up. The captain was about to take action to save the siege, but found that a sword energy had been locked between his eyebrows. The captain broke out in cold sweat and his body kept shaking. The several team members behind him had frightened expressions on their faces.
Zheng Feng took the initiative to attack, which was beyond their expectations. He was so powerful that he knocked away the green monkey with one move and locked the forehead of the captain with the highest level of cultivation with his sword energy. If Zheng Feng kills someone, the two of them will be killed in an instant. It only takes a blink of an eye to destroy this patrol. This is not the same level of combat power.
Three seconds is the blink of an eye. The patrol leader felt what it felt like to be in an instant and a thousand years. Every second was spent in panic, and every second was a long torment.
The patrol leader discovered that the sword had not penetrated his brain and that he was still alive. When he came to his senses, he decisively ordered, "Let them go!"
Zheng Feng bowed his hands and said, "If you have offended me just now, please forgive me. We have urgent matters and need to go on our way, so we won't bother you any more and we'll take our leave!"
As soon as Zheng Feng and others left, the disheveled green monkey jumped up and picked up the summons badge, "Urgent call for help. A group of pedestrians five hundred miles east of the village's water bay are suspicious. They refuse to be interrogated and maliciously hurt others. Ah!"
The patrol leader wanted to stop the green monkey's behavior, but found that with the screams, the green monkey's head flew up again, but this time only the head flew up.
"I didn't mean to hurt anyone!" A voice came slowly, and the patrol members could clearly hear it, it was Zheng Feng's voice. The sound was far away from here.
"This person is not something we can mess with. As you all saw just now, this group of people had no intention of taking action. It was the Green Monkey who pressed hard against him!" The captain was very helpless. The Green Monkey was the cause of his own trouble.
After a while, a group of people came very quickly, all riding tall horses. They looked like a nearby rider patrol.
"Who killed the green monkey, and where is he?" A leader in green clothes rode up to ask.
Everyone didn't know how to answer. The key was that he had spared everyone's lives just now. The sword that killed the green monkey was still fresh in everyone's memory. If he could kill the green monkey silently, he could kill any one of them. He was kind-hearted and spared the patrol members twice. Can you report him now?
The patrol member was silent, but as the patrol leader, the nearby patrol team came to support, but he had to answer.
"Did you escape?" a rider asked, his eyes full of contempt.
"The other party was already far away when the Green Monkey sent the message!" The captain wanted to tell the leader in Tsing Yi to stop. Although the leader in Tsing Yi was a junior Martial Lord, the patrol leader also felt that he was no match for Zheng Feng.
"Haha, I'm joking. The Qing Monkey sent the message so far and it only took a few words. Could it be that someone who had already moved away came back and killed him in an instant?" The Qingyi captain didn't believe it, and none of the riders who followed him believed it.
"Let's go, our team will chase them! Please point me in the direction." The leader in Qingyi galloped his horse, and several horses galloped away.
"Let's go back and continue patrolling. No one needs to mention what happened just now."The leader of the team knew exactly what would happen to this group of riders. He had just passed the gate of hell not long ago. If Zheng Feng hadn't been so kind and gentle, he almost went in. I have also implicitly reminded the other party of his strength. As a patrol leader, I cannot explicitly give up tracking. That would be dereliction of duty.
The patrol leader led several team members and continued patrolling in the direction they came from. Just pretend that what happened just now didn't happen, and he never wants to experience the excitement just now again.
